title: Ask toward an open problem: Peto's paradox
statement: Propose five candidate un-asked questions, each smaller than the open problem below and each such that its answer would bear on it. Problem OP-MED-PETO: Why does cancer risk not rise across species with body size and lifespan, although larger and longer-lived animals have more cell divisions in which to acquire mutations? Each candidate must pass the Depth requirement of LEDGER.md, must not be a duplicate of ledger/INDEX.md, must not be the problem itself or a known reformulation of it, and must carry a bears_on link to OP-MED-PETO saying how its answer would bear on the problem.

problem_source.title: Peto's Paradox: evolution's prescription for cancer prevention
